Our Story

Ali's Mission

Elctration and Plumber Maintenance Working was founded with a simple mission: deliver honest, fast, high-quality Electrical & Plumbing service to valued customers. Ali built this company from the ground up, one satisfied customer at a time.

Today, with a team of licensed technicians and dozens of five-star reviews, we're proud to be Bahrain's most trusted Electrical & Plumbing contractor. Every job gets our full attention and best work.

  • Licensed Electrical & Plumbing contractor — Texas certified
  • Fully insured for your peace of mind
  • Same-day service available for urgent needs
  • Friendly, professional crew every time
  • Transparent pricing — no hidden fees
  • Serving All Bahrain 🇧🇭 and surrounding areas
